title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Security Copilot insights on policy coverage (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
notes: claim 65: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents a plugin-enablement PowerShell operation that the briefing reports as undocumented, and its current Security Copilot guidance explicitly excludes government-cloud use rather than leaving that question unstated. The roadmap dates and preview prerequisites are accurate, but the claims that the feature is read-only and leaves end users unaffected go beyond the documented description.

Use a plugin-name placeholder rather than inventing the Purview plugin identifier.
